description: Four crossfaders, each sweeping one knob across up to four mono sources, with links that gang neighbouring channels

params.text: Sets how many sources that channel's sweep runs through, 1 to 4
Sweeps across that channel's sources, 0% at the first and 100% at the last
Links that channel to the one on its right, in the way the Link Mode menu item chooses

inputs.text: One of the sources that channel crossfades between
Moves that channel's sweep, a tenth of its voltage added to its xFD knob, with the total held between 0% and 100%

menu: Link Mode: xFD + Inputs, xFD only — chooses what a lit L button gangs: the linked inputs pooled into one longer crossfade on the first channel's knob and output, or the knobs alone
